# Far & Wide

> A personal travel journal — slow notes, photographs, and stories from places worth remembering.

Far & Wide is a personal collection of travel stories and destinations. Each entry is a long-form postcard about somewhere the author has walked through, written in an unhurried, editorial voice.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Featured destination, latest entries, and newsletter signup.
- [All destinations](/destinations): Index of every published travel entry, in order.
- [About](/about): About the journal and the writer behind it.
- [Contact](/contact): Email, social links, and newsletter signup.

## Content

- [Destination entries](/destination/): Individual travel stories, one per destination. Each includes a title, location, visit date, summary, long-form story, and photo gallery.
